cards.text: Archie appears the way he always does — already mid-sentence, as though the conversation started before you arrived and you're just catching up.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "There you are. I was going to text but this is more efficient. You look like someone currently doing something mildly reckless. Carry on, I'm not your mum."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "I do try." He nods once, like that's the whole conversation, and drifts back into whatever he was doing before he clocked you.
